summary: Steel fire tower built 1940 in the Black Hills; removed in the 1960s or 1970s (sources disagree). No source describes what remains today.

facts.status_note: Removed. Sources date the removal to the 1960s or the 1970s, and none describes what remains on the summit.

events.note: Register Built field and lookout history page both give 1940; the history page says steel tower

Register gives the 1970s; the year 1970 is a placeholder within that decade, and the lookout history page says gone in the 1960s

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says the 1970s; lookout history page says gone in the 1960s; a 1962 report shows the lookout in use that August. The sources do not settle the year, so the record's 1970 is kept as a placeholder within the 1970s, with a note.
Register says Fall River County. A lookout page and a South Dakota list say Custer County. The register's county is kept.

notes_for_editor: No source describes the site today, so no access fact is recorded. Removal year conflicts (register 1970s vs lookout page 1960s). County and coordinates conflict: the register gives Fall River County and 43.500252, -103.901869 (the record matches), while the South Dakota list gives Custer County and 43.45999, -103.90388. Staffing evidence is a single 1962 item, quoted from the Rapid City Journal on a lookout page; the original newspaper was not checked.
